source: Extracted from mcpmarket.com listing pages + each server's GitHub README (bundled locally — no live fetch needed).

servers.name: Chrome DevTools
servers.description: Drive Chrome via CDP: navigate, screenshot, read console + network, capture performance traces.
servers.sandbox: Run inside the E2B sandbox: npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp (needs a Chrome/Chromium in the sandbox, or connect it to a headless Chrome the sandbox starts).

tools.name: list_console_messages
tools.description: List all console messages for the currently selected page since the last navigation.

tools.name: get_console_message
tools.description: Gets a console message by its ID. You can get all messages by calling ${listConsoleMessages.name}.

tools.name: emulate_network
tools.description: Emulates network conditions such as throttling or offline mode on the selected page.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Clicks on the provided element

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Hover over the provided element

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Type text into a input, text area or select an option from a <select> element.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag an element onto another element

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill out multiple form elements at once

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file through a provided element.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key or key combination. Use this when other input methods like fill() cannot be used (e.g., keyboard shortcuts, navigation keys, or special key combinations).

tools.name: list_network_requests
tools.description: List all requests for the currently selected page since the last navigation.

tools.name: get_network_request
tools.description: Gets a network request by URL. You can get all requests by calling ${listNetworkRequests.name}.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Get a list of pages open in the browser.

tools.name: select_page
tools.description: Select a page as a context for future tool calls.

tools.name: close_page
tools.description: Closes the page by its index. The last open page cannot be closed.

tools.name: new_page
tools.description: Creates a new page

tools.name: navigate_page
tools.description: Navigates the currently selected page to a URL.

tools.name: handle_dialog
tools.description: If a browser dialog was opened, use this command to handle it

tools.name: performance_start_trace
tools.description: Starts a performance trace recording on the selected page. This can be used to look for performance problems and insights to improve the performance of the page. It will also report Core Web Vital (CWV) scores for the page.

tools.name: performance_stop_trace
tools.description: Stops the active performance trace recording on the selected page.

tools.name: performance_analyze_insight
tools.description: Provides more detailed information on a specific Performance Insight that was highlighted in the results of a trace recording.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the page or element.

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.description:
Take a text snapshot of the currently selected page based on the a11y tree. The snapshot lists page elements along with a unique
identifier (uid). Always use the latest snapshot. Prefer taking a snapshot over taking a screenshot.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for the specified text to appear on the selected page.

servers.name: Serena
servers.description: Semantic code intelligence: LSP-powered symbols, references, edits and refactors over codebases.
servers.sandbox: Inside the E2B sandbox: install uv, then `uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent` and run `serena start-mcp-server --context codex`. IMPORTANT (upstream README): do NOT use marketplace/plugin-manager install commands — they are outdated.
servers.note: Project must be on disk (workspace files) for Serena to index it.

servers.name: 2ools
servers.description: Build, version, review and export websites, web apps and games from inside chat. Free tool: create_public_preview turns an HTML doc into a viewable URL.

remote.auth: OAuth — sign in + Authorize once in a browser. Retrieve https://2ools.app/start non-visually (HTTP fetch, not the in-app browser) and follow its 'For your AI' steps.

servers.register_hint: manage_mcp action 'create' with transport streamable_http, url https://2ools.app/mcp — then complete OAuth in the app browser when the agent opens it.

servers.name: Superpowers
servers.description: Extended agent-capabilities toolkit (brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, dispatching-parallel-agents, using-git-worktrees …).
servers.sandbox: Distribution is per-harness plugins (Claude Code: /plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official; other harnesses per its README). An npm package 'superpowers' also exists — check its usage on npmjs before running it blind.
servers.note: NOT an MCP stdio server — it is a skills/hook plugin collection. In the E2B sandbox, read its README and use the CLI/plugin path it documents.

servers.name: TubeAlfred YouTube
servers.description: YouTube automation through TubeAlfred (search, playlists, channel actions).
servers.sandbox: Run inside the E2B sandbox: npx -y @tubealfred/mcp (an MCP client script with @modelcontextprotocol/sdk spawns it and lists/calls its tools).

servers.name: ChatGPT Redis
servers.description: Redis-backed memory/context store for conversational agents (memory_query, memory_store, memory_list_tables, memory_annotate_table).

remote.auth: Free signup at https://freebase.cloud → Settings → MCP → New Token → copy the token URL (the token IS the path; no auth header).

servers.register_hint: manage_mcp action 'create' with transport streamable_http and the token URL from freebase.cloud.

servers.name: YouTube Search & Download
servers.description: Search YouTube and download videos/audio programmatically.
servers.sandbox: Inside the E2B sandbox: `uvx youtube-search-mcp` (or pip install youtube-search-mcp then run `youtube-search-mcp`). Needs yt-dlp + a YouTube cookie/header config for some requests.

servers.name: PDF Generator
servers.description: Generate PDF documents from HTML, plain text, or any URL.
servers.sandbox: Inside the E2B sandbox: git clone https://github.com/rumblingb/pdf-generator-mcp && cd pdf-generator-mcp && pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 server.py

tools.name: pdf_generate_from_html
tools.description: Generate PDF from HTML content

tools.name: pdf_generate_from_text
tools.description: Generate PDF from plain text

tools.name: pdf_generate_from_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL and convert to PDF

servers.note: Free tier: 50 PDFs/month; hosted/paid tier exists.

servers.name: Free Proxy List
servers.description: Fetch rotating lists of free proxy servers.
servers.register_hint: manage_mcp action 'create' with transport streamable_http, url https://mcp.hproxy.com/mcp — no auth needed.

servers.name: Site Shot

env_required.SITESHOT_API_KEY: Sign up at site-shot.com for the API key

servers.sandbox: Run inside the E2B sandbox: SITESHOT_API_KEY=<key> npx -y site-shot-mcp@1.2.0 (the API key is REQUIRED).
